column3: BootUI 2.4.0 skips null header names in HttpServletRequest/HttpServletResponse (BootUiHttpExchangesFilterTests.skipsNullRequestHeaderNamesWithoutLosingValidHeaders, skipsNullResponseHeaderNamesWithoutLosingValidHeadersOrTheServedBody); in ASGI 3.0, scope and response headers are binary (bytes, bytes) pairs and null header names cannot occur.

BootUI logs "BootUI skipped an HTTP exchange capture (X)" through one message for every recording failure; sharpit logs one warning per hook name ("sharpit capture hook request end failed (X); capture continues", "request start", "response"), so the failing step is named and a repeat of the same failure stays quiet; both log the exception class only.

When only the response-capture clock read fails, BootUI records no exchange (callbackRegistrationFailureStillServesTheResponse); sharpit logs the "response" hook failure, serves the response and still records the exchange at request end with the finish time taken there, because the row needs no callback registration.
